anomalies.message: The sky hums. It is the same note as before.
The sky hums from very far away, as if buried.
The sky hums flat and low, like a held breath.
The light flickers, as if remembering a different afternoon.
Beneath the village, something is being carried back again.
It would be easy to begin again. No one would mind.
You already know this is not the first time.
Fern has watched you arrive more than once.
